gis.provider: Purdue University ArcGIS REST, BuildingShapesZip4 FeatureServer layer 0
gis.source_crs: EPSG:4326 (requested); layer geometry metadata reports esriMeters for area/length fields
gis.method: Preserved all emitted polygon vertices. Converted lon/lat to the project local metric frame using X=(lon+86.9137)*111412.84*cos(40.4274deg), Y=(lat-40.4274)*111040, then subtracted the polygon bounding-box center as the asset-local anchor.
gis.uncertainty: The source Shape__Area value (838.125 m2 per metadata) exceeds the footprint's coordinate-derived bounding-box area (~527 m2), so it is internally inconsistent with the returned geometry. The vertex geometry was used; the area field was not used to scale the model. Existing asset report bounds differed from GIS by about 0.6m horizontally. Coordinate conversion uses the project's local tangent approximation.

building_information.provider: Purdue University Office of Emergency Preparedness
evidence: The official page identifies VA2 at 400 S University Street and says it is a two-floor building for research and teaching animals, including poultry, rodents, swine and small ruminants.
It says the second floor is an interstitial HVAC space and there is no basement.
It says a bathroom at the end of the building is designated as shelter-in-place space; it does not identify which end or reveal its plan.
building_information.uncertainty: GIS lists NUM_LEVELS=1 while OEP describes two floors. The model treats the occupied floor plus low HVAC interstitial as one roofline volume. Height is estimated; no dimensions or surveyed elevations were available. Interior layout and location of the bathroom are illustrative only.

imagery.provider: Esri World Imagery (provider attribution: Esri, Vantor, Earthstar Geographics, and GIS User Community)
imagery.method: Downloaded a 1200x1200 map export around the GIS footprint and visually aligned the long north-south roof, central dark service strip, repeated low rooftop units/exhausts, and east-side paved parking.
imagery.uncertainty: The displayed tile does not expose per-pixel acquisition date or a feature-specific imagery citation. Service metadata describes multiple resolutions/providers; the local tile's exact source/resolution cannot be established from this export. Imagery supports roof plan/details and surrounding paving, but not precise elevations, facade construction, windows, or interior.

modeling_decisions.height_m: Estimated 4.62m roof top, 4.87m parapet top; no direct height survey found. The GIS Extrution field is preserved as evidence but unit semantics are undocumented and is not used as a 15m building height.
modeling_decisions.materials: Procedural, self-contained shaders only; no external image texture dependencies. Restrained light gray warm wall panels, pale membrane roof, darker HVAC slots, and metallic service details are chosen conservatively from aerial appearance and building use; facade color/material are not verified by a photograph.
modeling_decisions.interior: Illustrative cleanable animal-care rooms, corridor, generic pens and wash fixtures. Included as contextual visualization based on the official stated use, not as an asserted representation of the actual inaccessible plan.
